title: Guests Judge Your Kitchen by Your Bathroom

scenes.say: Guests never see your kitchen. They see your bathroom.

scenes.speaker: Ivan
scenes.say: If the bathroom looks like that, what does the kitchen look like?

props.name: Ivan
props.quote: If the bathroom's like that, *the kitchen…*

scenes.say: The kitchen can be spotless. But the bathroom is the only back room a guest ever walks into, so it's the one they judge.

props.caption: Myth or *fact*?
props.myth: Guests only care about the food
props.fact: The bathroom is the only back room they ever see

scenes.say: So: check it every hour, and put a checklist on the door. Keep spare paper towels and soap right there. And a little plant or a candle goes a long way.

props.title: Fix the bathroom
steps: Check it hourly, sign the list
Spare towels and soap in reach
